title: runner_response/v1
description: Body of the agent's HTTP 200 response to POST /decide (IC-6): a single BARE action/v1 document - no response envelope (optionality like comment/usage lives inside action/v1, keeping the agent-side contract minimal, per the dev-plan sketch). Content-Type: application/json; body <= 65536 bytes; exactly one JSON document (trailing garbage = invalid_json). The harness content-addresses the VERBATIM response bytes into raw/ before any parsing - evidence first, interpretation second - so this schema constrains validity, never what gets recorded. Anything else (non-200, unparseable, schema-invalid, oversize) follows the IC-3 validation table and the IC-6 retry semantics.
